# Regulated-change benchmark

> Public benchmark of seven third-party reviewer configurations on 270 changes to a synthetic bank, checked against the bank's own obligations, with 136 changes held out and sealed.

## Read first

- [README](README.md): What the benchmark is, who it is for, and the held-out results.
- [Results](RESULTS.md): Full tables for the seen and held-out splits, regenerated from the published verdicts.
- [Protocol](PROTOCOL.md): How the benchmark was built, sealed, run, and scored.
- [Corrections](CORRECTIONS.md): What changed after the first public release. The held-out split is unchanged.
- [Results JSON](reports/results.json): The same results in JSON.

## Repository

- [Agent notes](AGENTS.md): Layout, setup, and the commands that regenerate the tables.
- [Platform specification](docs/platform.md): The synthetic mortgage and payments apps.
- [Obligation citations](obligations/citations.md): How each obligation maps to a public rule.
- [Sealed commitments](bench/key/COMMITMENTS.md): Hashes committed before scoring.
- [Seeder API](bench/seeder/API.md): How to regenerate changes with new seeds.
- [Baseline runners](baselines/README.md): The seven reviewer configurations and how each one ran.

## Optional

- [Code licence](LICENSE): Apache-2.0 for the code.
- [Data licence](LICENSE-DATA.md): CC BY 4.0 for the obligations, variants, keys, and verdicts.
